params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'; git -C $repo fetch origin main | Out-Null; $sha=(git -C $repo rev-parse origin/main).Trim(); $wt=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('mhw-current-main-'+$sha.Substring(0,12)); if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $wt){ git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $wt -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; git -C $repo worktree add --detach $wt $sha | Out-Null; try {;   Write-Output ('REMOTE_MAIN_SHA='+$sha);   Set-Location $wt;   python heaven-bridge/test_worker.py;   if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'bridge test_worker failed' };   python heaven-bridge/tests/test_worker.py;   if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'bridge compatibility tests failed' };   Set-Location (Join-Path $wt 'tools\agent-control');   npm.cmd run check;   if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'agent-control check failed' };   npm.cmd test;   if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'agent-control tests failed' };   Write-Output 'CURRENT_MAIN_BRIDGE_AND_QUOTA_TESTS_OK'; } finally { Set-Location $env:USERPROFILE; git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null; git -C $repo worktree prune }
